items.title: Scam Detection in Messages goes global, but the US gets a little something extra
items.summary: Google widens Scam Detection's to multiple countries, but saves the best bit for the US.
items.body: Credit: Brady Snyder / Android Authority TL;DR Google has released the September Pixel Drop with new Scam Detection features for its phones. The update expands the availability of Scam Detection in Google Messages to many more regions. Scam Detection now also works in third-party apps through Gboard, but this feature is limited to the US for now. After revealing a host of new features for a broad range of Android devices earlier this month, Samsung is now giving Pixel users new features. Beyond the new features in the latest September Pixel Drop , Google is expanding some existing features into new territories. One such feature is Scam Detection in Google Messages , which is now available in a host of countries and languages. Google has confirmed that alongside the US, Pixel’s Scam Detection in Google Messages is now available in Australia, Canada, France, Germany, India, Japan, Mexico, Singapore, and the UK. In addition to English, Pixel devices will be able to detect seemingly suspicious or rogue messages in Arabic, French, German, Japanese, Portuguese, and Spanish.

items.title: Google Translate is getting a major offline upgrade
items.summary: Offline Live Translate finally arrives, but only for newer Pixels.
items.body: TL;DR Live Translate lets you directly talk to speakers of other languages, but so far has required a data connection. Google Translate is now adding offline Live support. Conversations are supported between English and French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Spanish, Hindi, Indonesian, Japanese, Russian, and Swedish. Our phones are fantastic tools for helping us deal with unfamiliar situations, but all too often that requires having an active data connection — which can be far from a certainty, depending on where we’re going. That’s exactly why it’s so important to have offline options for some of those most critical tools, like offline support in Google Maps . Earlier this year we spotted Google working towards another new offline mode, as it prepared support for Live Translate without a data connection . And now we’re finally starting to see it arrive. When we last took a peek at Googles in-development efforts back in May, it appeared that we could expect offline Live Translate support for at least English, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, and Spanish.

items.summary: Galaxy phone owners are struggling to get the navigation bar to hide.
items.body: Credit: Aamir Siddiqui / Android Authority TL;DR Galaxy owners are reporting an issue with the navigation bar when using NavStar. The navigation bar does not disappear when using NavStar’s hide function. Samsung has acknowledged the issue and says it will be resolved in a future update. NavStar, a Good Lock module , lets you customize the navigation bar on Galaxy phones in all kinds of ways. For example, you can change the look of the icons, or even tack on additional buttons. However, one of its most useful functions is no longer working properly for some. NavStar has an option that allows you to hide the navigation bar if you don’t want to see it all the time. According to a Galaxy S25 Plus user reporting on Samsung’s community forum , this feature is malfunctioning. Even when unpinned, the bar will remain in place and won’t go down. It appears that tapping the pin/hide button does nothing.

items.title: Looks like Samsung Gallery has already found its OneDrive replacement
items.summary: Surprise, you're using Google Photos.
items.body: TL;DR Samsung is ending a partnership with Microsoft that saw images backed up from Samsung Gallery stored in OneDrive. OneDrive will instead back up photos to Google’s cloud storage in the future. Images stored this way will be accessible in both Samsung Gallery and Google Photos. Samsung announced earlier this year that it would stop working with Microsoft OneDrive to store user images and videos in the cloud. That partnership is officially ending at the end of September , and preparations for nixing the functionality have already begun. Now that Microsoft is on its way out, we’ve learned Samsung will partner with Google for cloud storage going forward. As spotted by X user Sandeep Adap , a new version of Samsung’s Gallery Cloud Sync service has popped up on the Galaxy Store. The service’s description specifies that it backs up photos and videos in Google Cloud.

items.body: In April, the world watched as four humans circled the Moon for the first time in over 50 years with NASA’s Artemis II mission. On Saturday, Sept. 19, the public is invited to look up again with NASA events across the country, including the International Observe the Moon Night celebration held at NASA’s Goddard Space Flight Center Visitor Center in Greenbelt, Maryland. This year, NASA will celebrate International Observe the Moon Night with people around the world on Sept. 19. NASA/Vi Nguyen International Observe the Moon Night is an annual celebration that brings people together to learn about the Moon and explore our connection to Earth’s nearest celestial neighbor. Since the program began in 2010, people around the world have participated through lunar observations, hands-on activities, artwork, music, and more. At NASA Goddard, this year’s celebration will highlight the agency’s ongoing exploration of the Moon, including the historic Artemis II mission. The 41-show run was their first together in 16 years following their 2009 breakup, coming after years of public sniping as they embarked on divergent, yet successful, solo careers. items.title: ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Has Led Billboard’s Top Soundtracks Chart for 60 Weeks: Only One Soundtrack Has Led Longer (Full List)
items.summary: Will the K-pop megahit take the lead? We'll soon see.
items.body: KPop Demon Hunters has slayed on Billboard ’s Top Soundtracks chart, having led the list for 60 weeks – just two weeks shy of the record. This chart was introduced a little more than 25 years ago – on June 30, 2001 – which means it doesn’t include blockbuster soundtracks of previous eras, such as West Side Story, The Sound of Music, Doctor Zhivago, Saturday Night Fever and Purple Rain . Actually, it does include one – The Vince Guaraldi Trio ’s 1965 TV soundtrack, A Charlie Brown Christmas – but only because of its chart success since 2001. KPop Demon Hunters has been No. 1 for all but four of its 64 weeks on Top Soundtracks, having yielded for one week each to Wicked: For Good , the holiday perennial A Charlie Brown Christmas , Charli xcx ’s Wuthering Heights and the soundtrack to this year’s most-talked about TV miniseries, Heated Rivalry . items.body: انطلاق المفاوضات من أرضية إيجابية بدأ نادي برشلونة، التحرك فعليًا من أجل تجديد عقد البرازيلي رافينيا، ليستمر فترة أطول داخل القلعة الكتالونية، في ظل تألقه اللافت تحت قيادة المدرب الألماني هانز فليك. ذكرت صحيفة " سبورت " الكتالونية، أن المدير الرياضي ديكو عقد اجتماعاً مطولاً مع البرازيلي رافينيا بعد ظهر اليوم الثلاثاء في أحد المطاعم، بهدف إحراز تقدم في ملف تجديد عقد اللاعب الذي يمتد حالياً حتى عام 2028. وأضافت الصحيفة: "لقد كان اجتماعاً غير رسمي ولكنه مهم، وجاء في إطار حوار يتسم بتوافق تام في الرؤى بين جميع الأطراف، فضلاً عن رغبة اللاعب الصريحة في مواصلة ارتداء قميص "البلوجرانا". ومع ذلك، تُعد هذه الخطوة بمثابة تحرك أولي من النادي بشأن التجديد ، ولا توجد أي عجلة للتوصل إلى اتفاق نهائي؛ إذ لا يزال في عقد رافينيا قرابة عامين، كما أن التزامه تجاه برشلونة راسخ ومطلق. يشعر اللاعب البرازيلي بسعادة غامرة في برشلونة، حيث يصب تركيزه على تحقيق أهداف الموسم، مؤدياً في الوقت ذاته دوره كأحد القادة الرئيسيين للفريق الكتالوني حسبما ذكرت الصحيفة. ينطوي الموقف أيضاً على جانب فريد؛ إذ لا يمتلك رافينيا حالياً وكيلاً لأعماله، ويتولى بنفسه إدارة النقاشات المتعلقة بمستقبله، ونتيجة لذلك، يشارك اللاعب البرازيلي مباشرة في الاجتماعات مع النادي، ويكون على دراية تامة بكافة تفاصيل المفاوضات التي تؤثر على مسيرت…

items.title: A Galaxy Z Fold 8 bug is putting apps in places where they shouldn’t be — here’s how to fix it
items.summary: Apps are randomly relocating to strange places on the Galaxy Z Fold 8.
items.body: Credit: Hadlee Simons / Android Authority TL;DR Galaxy Z Fold 8 owners are reporting an issue with app misalignment. App icons are moving into areas where they shouldn’t be, and users can’t relocate them. Samsung has confirmed the issue and says that the bug has been fixed in Home Up v18.0.00.36. The Galaxy Z Fold 8 has been a hit since its release, outpacing Samsung’s expectations . If you were one of the many who picked up the wide foldable, you may have recently encountered a bizarre bug related to app placement. The good news is that Samsung has noticed this glitch and has a fix available. The issue at hand is causing apps to appear in locations where they shouldn’t be. On Samsung’s community forum, Galaxy Z Fold 8 owners are sharing screenshots of app icons overlapping other icons on the home layout. Some apps are even relocating to areas beyond their borders.

items.title: Android’s new cross-device hub is starting to roll out — just in time for Googlebooks
items.summary: Tasks, apps, notifications, and files can now follow you across devices.
items.body: TL;DR Google has started rolling out a new Continue activity hub through Google Play Services on Android 17. It introduces controls for continuing tasks and apps while sharing notifications, files, and media across devices. The rollout lands just ahead of the Googlebook launch, pushing Google’s broader cross-device vision closer to reality. Googlebooks aren’t going to be laptops meant to exist on their own, and the more interesting part promises to be what happens when you put one next to your Android phone. Google has spent months laying that groundwork, from Android 17’s Continue On task handoff to Play Services’ hooks for Googlebook setup and experiments that could turn your phone into a laptop trackpad . Now, one of the clearest pieces of that cross-device puzzle is starting to appear on phones. We’ve spotted a new “Continue activity” section rolling out through Google Play Services on a Pixel 9 running stable Android 17. It sits inside the existing Cross-device services menu alongside Call casting and Internet sharing, promising to let you “continue tasks and access apps, media, and notifications across your devices.”

items.title: Received a Spotify link as a YouTube Music user? SongFlip fixes the mismatch with no extra taps
items.summary: This app solves a lot of your group chat headaches.
items.body: Credit: Zac Kew-Denniss / Android Authority TL;DR SongFlip solves cross-platform music link mismatches by automatically opening shared URLs in your preferred music streaming service. Built on Android’s App Links system, it features zero-click background redirection, Share Sheet and clipboard fallbacks, and Shazam interception. The Android app is free and ad-free, featuring an optional Pro tier for song history. There’s also a web tool for outgoing link conversion, and an iOS TestFlight beta. Between Spotify , YouTube Music , and Apple Music , most of us have picked a side in the streaming wars, but our friends and family rarely land on the same platform. In my case, I juggle Apple Music and YouTube Music, while most of my social circles share tracks via either Spotify or YouTube Music. Tapping a song link shared in a group chat usually ends in annoyance: landing on the wrong app or a sluggish web preview, leaving me to manually copy and search the title myself, and I know a bunch of people don’t even bother at all. items.summary: Spotify's algorithm can now ignore all those nursery rhymes your kids have been using your account for.
items.body: TL;DR Spotify is rolling out a new setting that lets parents stop kids’ and family music from influencing their recommendations. Turning it off keeps children’s music out of features like Discover Weekly, Daily Mix, and even 2026 Wrapped. The change works retroactively and is available globally on mobile for both Free and Premium users. After a successful pilot launch, Spotify’s Managed Accounts made their way to all US-based users earlier this summer, allowing parents to give their kids their own space on Spotify, all while maintaining control over their listening environment and habits. However, even when kids have access to their own space on Spotify, there are bound to be moments, like car rides, when you inevitably end up playing their music from your own account. Thankfully, Spotify has come up with a new way to keep that from interfering with your own recommendations. Managed Accounts keep your kids’ listening history separate from your own, but doesn’t really help when you’re actively playing children’s music from your own account. items.title: Good news for carsick passengers: Android Motion Assist is rolling out to more devices
items.summary: Google's motion sickness feature is now coming to your Android phone.
items.body: Credit: Joe Maring / Android Authority TL;DR Motion Assist is now rolling out to more Android devices. The feature is designed to reduce motion sickness by displaying small dots on the edge of your screen that move in real time to help synchronize what your eyes see and your body feels while riding in a vehicle. Motion Assist requires Android 17 or higher to render the dots across all system surfaces. Motion sickness is a very common condition. While some people are more susceptible to it than others, enough motion can get anyone feeling a little green. Google recently released a new feature for Pixel owners called Motion Assist to help combat motion sickness . Now, that feature is spreading to more Android devices. According to Google’s Mishaal Rahman , Android’s Motion Assist feature is now rolling out beyond Pixel phones. So, if you’re a passenger in a moving vehicle, you can now turn this feature on to help reduce the likelihood of getting motion sick. The feature requires Android 17 or higher to render the dots across all system surfaces.

items.body: NASA has selected 12 new investigations to help support human explorers in space. Six will help advance the ability to produce food off-planet, while another six advance the understanding of how unique conditions associated with space exploration can impact the health and physiology of astronauts. The six food-focused investigations, supported by the agency’s Space Crops grants, advance NASA’s goal of harnessing the power of plants to enhance quality of life for humans in space, as well as to enable lunar and Mars exploration. Four of the space crops proposals focus on studies of edible plants and how their growth, physiology, and associated microbial communities are affected by environmental conditions in space or on other planetary bodies. Another proposal involves understanding mechanisms by which certain plant species, called resurrection plants, can withstand extreme, dry conditions. The last space crops proposal builds on previous studies on the International Space Station to uncover functions of algal genes, segments of DNA controlling algae survival, whose expression is modified by spaceflight. items.title: Lenovo Smart Clock Essential owners are waking up to missing weather
items.summary: The Lenovo Smart Clock Essential is slowly becoming just a clock.
items.body: TL;DR Lenovo Smart Clock Essential owners report that the weather icon and outdoor temperatures are disappearing from their displays. Voice forecasts still work, but factory resets, reboots, and other attempted fixes have produced inconsistent results. Reports continue to surface across several countries, but the cause remains unknown. Lenovo’s little bedside clocks have spent years quietly doing the basics well: waking people up, answering questions, controlling smart-home devices, and showing the weather at a glance. That usefulness has survived Google’s messy transition from Assistant to Gemini , but earlier this year, owners of the standard Smart Clock lost convenient touchscreen controls for their smart lights . And now, some Lenovo Smart Clock Essential users are missing another deceptively useful feature: the weather display. Affected clocks no longer show the weather icon or outdoor temperature, leaving only the time. Before-and-after photos show the complete time, weather, and temperature readout reduced to just the clock.

Users have reported crashes, repeated responses, and Gemini creating duplicate timers after hearing its own confirmation. Google has acknowledged the bug and is rolling out improvements, although it hasn’t provided a completion timeline. Earlier this year, some Android Auto users watched Gemini Live hear its own voice and spiral into a conversation with itself. In-car audio setups emerged as a possible culprit, but similar behavior is now surfacing on some Google Home devices. The good news? Google has now acknowledged the bug and says improvements are rolling out. The issue surfaced on Reddit after a Google Home user said Gemini Live had become unusable. Responding last Friday, the official Google Nest Community account confirmed that Live Mode was interrupting itself on some devices and said improvements were rolling out.

Samsung says it is reviewing its pricing but has made no final decision, with no indication of a US increase. When Apple announced the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max , higher prices than last year’s models felt inevitable. But few expected Apple to use the launch to raise prices on its older iPhones . Now, Android’s biggest name may be reading from the same playbook, as a Korean outlet claims Samsung is considering an unusual post-launch price hike for the Galaxy S26 series. According to Hans Economy , a South Korean carrier has informed retailers that wholesale prices for every Galaxy S26 model will rise by 149,600 won (about $110) on October 1. That would be unusual because Samsung launched the phones in March, putting the alleged price hike nearly seven months into their life cycle.

items.title: Apple’s Handoff lets two iPhones share one number, but it won’t come cheap

items.body: TL;DR Apple’s new Handoff feature, which lets you use the same number on two iPhones, won’t be free. T-Mobile, the only carrier to support Handoff at launch, will cost an extra $5 per month. T-Mobile says both phones should be able to use crucial features like calling, SMS, data, and even T-Satellite. The iPhone 18 Pro , which Apple announced last week, lacks any significant upgrade other than its new chip. Even the new camera Apple touted adds a feature Android brands have had for years . Irrespective of that, something that makes the iPhone 18 Pro truly compelling is the ability to use another iPhone with the same phone number, much like you would with an Apple Watch. This feature is called “Handoff, ” and it currently requires carrier support. That means only a handful of carriers will initially support it and may charge you more for the service, especially as they’re giving you the opportunity to sell you another line. At launch, T-Mobile is the only carrier in the US to support Handoff, while Verizon is likely to add support in the coming months.

ACR can still collect information about viewing habits when enabled, raising broader questions about whether users truly understand what they’re consenting to during TV setup. Your TV is probably one of the last gadgets in your home you expect to worry about from a privacy standpoint. You turn it on, spend 20 minutes deciding what to watch, give up and rewatch something familiar, and eventually switch it off. At least, that’s how most of us think about it. But smart TVs are effectively giant connected computers in our living rooms, which means they can collect far more information than the old dumb TVs they replaced .
